messages.author: 5140016d70f6ba82
messages.subject: Re: stratum vs sample-level density estimates
parts:
Well it sounds suspicious but when you say you computed a mean -- how
did you do that? If you used a standard mean and your samples have
different lengths and your short lines have the high density then what
you described can happen, but without having more details I can't really
help.

--jeff
